vectors.purpose: The complete format-2 budget history replays; the head is the record-chain tip (SPEC §4.3), the state root is the §7 derivation over the final state and the projection head the §12 chain.
The prefix ending with cp:1 replays; the result's stateRoot is rootAt(24), the root AFTER the checkpoint's own event record (the checkpoint's data.stateRoot is rootAt(23), the state before it).
The prefix ending with cp:2 replays; the result's stateRoot is rootAt(33), the root AFTER the checkpoint's own event record (the checkpoint's data.stateRoot is rootAt(32), the state before it).
The prefix ending with cp:3 replays; the result's stateRoot is rootAt(36), the root AFTER the checkpoint's own event record (the checkpoint's data.stateRoot is rootAt(35), the state before it).
A format-2 history of one event: the head is recordHash(0) = sha256("irontrellis-record/2" ‖ 0x00 ‖ 0^32 ‖ eventHash ‖ be64(0)); the state has three records (genesis, ownerKeyEpoch 0, event 0).
A format-2 event that spells an Amount as the legacy {"$continuity.bigint"} marker is a schema violation (SPEC §3.4).
Format 2 Amounts are non-negative decimal strings; "-1" is a schema violation.
An Amount with a leading zero ("060") is not canonical.
A genesis that declares eventSchemaVersion irontrellis-event/2 but the format-1 control-authorization literal is refused.
A format-2 genesis must declare domain.version "2".
A control event signed over the head before it cannot be moved: swapping two control events breaks both signatures.
BUDGET_DECLARED is a control event; without controlAuthorization it is refused.
A budget must cap at least one dimension (SPEC §9.1).
A FIXED_WINDOW period needs lengthMs ≥ 1.
Declaring a budgetId twice (a properly owner-signed second BUDGET_DECLARED) is TRANSITION_INVALID.
A properly signed BUDGET_UPDATED for a budget that was never declared is TRANSITION_INVALID.
Changing a declared cap after signing breaks the owner signature (the effect hash is signed).

spend:2 re-declared and re-admitted at amount 45 (authority allows ≤ 100; b-amount has 60 used of 100): a correctly signed admission the budgets refuse is TRANSITION_INVALID, because replay re-derives the decision and finds DENY.
A format-2 TRANSACTION_INTENT_DECLARED without declarationAuthorization is a schema violation (SPEC §8.6).
A declaration signed by a key that is not the session credential is DECLARATION_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.
The declaration signature binds the amount: changing it after signing fails verification.
The nonce record is created at declaration (SPEC §7.2, §8.6): a correctly signed second declaration with the same (actorId, nonce) and a new intentId is TRANSITION_INVALID.
A correctly signed BUDGET refusal whose recorded code/budgetId differ from the re-derived decision at its head is REFUSAL_NOT_REPRODUCED.
Changing the code after signing breaks the session signature: REFUSAL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID (checked before re-derivation).
A refusal recorded for a request the state allows (amount 5 at that head) is REFUSAL_NOT_REPRODUCED; the signature is valid, the claim is false.
A refusal must cite the head immediately before it; an earlier head is TRANSITION_INVALID.
refusalSource CONNECTOR requires the connector record; a BUDGET source may not carry one (closed schema, SPEC §10.1).
A refusal signed by a key other than the named session credential is REFUSAL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.
A STATE_CHECKPOINT whose stateRoot is not the §7 root of the state before it is STATE_ROOT_MISMATCH (owner-signed, so the signature is re-made here).
recordCount must equal the number of state records (leaves).
projectionHead must equal the §12 projection chain at the head before the checkpoint.
A checkpoint must cite the head immediately before it.
EFFECT_RECORDED needs an admitted intent.
The effect signature binds the measured amount.
A correctly wrapped envelope naming a counterparty that is not registered is TRANSITION_INVALID.
An envelope whose signature does not verify under the registered key is COUNTERPARTY_SIGNATURE_INVALID.
The second envelope must cite the digest of the first accepted envelope from the same counterparty.
Altering the envelope after both signatures breaks the counterparty signature, which is checked first: COUNTERPARTY_SIGNATURE_INVALID.
The envelope binds the history (historyId = recordHash(0)); an envelope signed for another history is TRANSITION_INVALID even with valid signatures.
The envelope binds the intent (intentDigest = the declaration challenge hash); a digest of another intent is TRANSITION_INVALID.
Registering a counterpartyId that is ACTIVE again is TRANSITION_INVALID (owner-signed, so the signature is re-made).
A valid counterparty envelope whose session wrapper was signed over a different envelope digest is RECORD_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.
An admission whose request.metric ("bytes") differs from the declared intent's metric (absent = "amount") is TRANSITION_INVALID, so a session cannot choose which budgets are checked and charged.
A CORE/BUDGET refusal must be signed by a session of the actor it names (request.actorId); spender's session refusing on behalf of "other" is TRANSITION_INVALID.
A refusal's evaluationTime must equal the event timestamp (as for admissions); a later evaluation time is TRANSITION_INVALID.
A CONNECTOR refusal must be signed by the connector's own session: connector.connectorId must equal the signing session's agent. Signed by spender's session it is TRANSITION_INVALID.
For measurer.kind SESSION, measurer.id must be the signing session's agent; "other" is TRANSITION_INVALID.
A BUDGET_UPDATED that leaves every cap null is a schema violation (SPEC §9.1).
carryUnused: true requires a non-null carryCap (SPEC §9.1, B-4): the rollover is then bounded.
subjects is a closed record of actorIds, roleIds, actions, resources; an extra key is a schema violation.
Period 1 of b-amount after the cap was lowered 100 → 60 at t=1100: the rollover of 5 earned under the old cap is frozen (carryBase), so allowed = 60 + 5, used 55: amount 10 is allowed exactly.
Amount 11 exceeds 60 + 5 − 55 (the frozen rollover is not re-priced by the lower cap).
g-role (roleIds [cashier], actorIds null, perOperationCap 30 on petty-cash-4) matches spender through the CURRENT cashier tenure: amount 30 is allowed (f-expired no longer matches).
Amount 35 on petty-cash-4 fails g-role, which matches by role, not by actor: BUDGET_PER_OPERATION_EXCEEDED with budgetId g-role.
d-perop's subjects were updated to cover petty-cash-3 (usage retained): amount 41 there fails d-perop before e-future is consulted.
d-perop caps a single operation on petty-cash-2 at 40.
Amount 41 on petty-cash-2 exceeds d-perop perOperationCap 40.
Amount 101 exceeds the grant maxAmount 100: the authority code wins, no budget is consulted.
e-future (origin 2000) has no period at t < 2000: BUDGET_PERIOD_UNDEFINED.
f-expired expired at 1050; at t it no longer matches.
c-count (countCap 3, closed) no longer matches; only b-amount applies.
A zero amount passes every cap.
A request with metric "bytes" matches no budget (all declare "amount"); authority still decides.
An evaluation time before the head is CAUSAL_TIME_INVALID regardless of budgets.
At cp:2 (period 0) b-amount has used 95 of 100: amount 5 is allowed.
Amount 6 exceeds the remaining 5 of period 0.
Headroom of b-amount at t=1100 after the cap lowering (60, carryBase {1, 5}): period 1, used 55, carryIn 5 (frozen), remaining 10.
The same state viewed at t=500 (period 0, before the carry base): used 95, carryIn 0, remaining max(0, 60 − 95) = 0 under the current cap (a pure view).
At t=2500 (period 2): rollover from the base: unused(1) = 60 + 5 − 55 = 10 → carryIn 10, remaining 70.
At t=1,000,000,500 (period 1,000,000) after 999,998 idle periods: closed form min(carryCap 50, 10 + n·60) = 50 → remaining 110, computed in O(periods with usage), never O(elapsed periods).
At the cp:3 head (before BUDGET_UPDATED lowered the cap): period 1, used 55, carryIn 5, remaining 50.
A closed budget reports active:false with its last usage.
Before its origin a FIXED_WINDOW budget has periodIndex null and is not active.
An unknown budgetId yields null.
At cp:1 (before BUDGET_UPDATED) c-count shows countCap 2 fully used.
An owner attestation of the final head with the matching state root and projection head.
A valid signature over a wrong state root: signatureValid and prefix hold, stateRootValid does not.
A valid signature over a wrong projection head.
An attestation by a key that is not an owner key in force.
An attestation of an earlier head (cp:1) verifies against the full history: prefix, root and projection at that position.
A head whose hash is not the record hash at its position.

The body names the domain; an attestation whose domain label is not this history's domain is reported signatureValid false (the signature may verify over the bytes, but the body is not an attestation of this history).

The export view from the cp:1 position to the cp:3 position: both ends carry the head, the §7 root at that position (the state after the event at that position) and the projection head; the events and the checkpoints in range are listed.
A format-1 history (copied verbatim from conformance/v1 accepts-signed-handover) still replays under IronTrellis Core; stateRoot and projectionHead are null for formats other than 2.
A continuity-event/0.2 history (copied verbatim from conformance/legacy) still replays; stateRoot and projectionHead are null.
A format-1 history carrying a format-2 event kind (BUDGET_DECLARED) is UNSUPPORTED_EVENT_TYPE, as before.
